verdicts.why: Known 'as quickly as possible' glossed 'as soon as you can' is a near-synonym of the seed's 'as quickly as possible', which the L3 LEGO also covers, so it is about its own sentence and not provably an orphan.
'ਰਹੇ ਹੋ' glossed 'are -ing' is a literal gloss of progressive auxiliaries whose English 'are' is in the seed ('What are you looking for?') but not contiguous with 'looking'.
'ਦੀ ਗੱਲ' glossed 'a matter of' is a literal gloss of the L1 LEGO 'ਹੈਰਾਨੀ ਦੀ ਗੱਲ => a surprise', so it is about its own sentence.
'not in the way' is a gloss of the L2 LEGO 'not in the same way', and the seed has 'in exactly the same way' with 'wouldn't' interposed.
'ਨੂੰ' glossed 'to' is the dative marker in L3 'ਆਪਣੇ ਭਰਾ ਨੂੰ => her brother', which the English sentence does not render separately.
'ਹਨ' glossed 'are' is the copula inside L2 'ਦੇ ਦੋਵੇਂ ਹੱਥ ਉੱਪਰ ਹਨ', and the seed renders it as 'has ... hands up' with no 'are'.
The row matches its LEGO L3 'ਉਸਨੇ ਖੁਦ ਨੂੰ ਜ਼ਖ਼ਮੀ ਕੀ ਹੈ', which has a 'ਕੀ ਹੈ' typo, so the LEGO disagrees with the seed's 'ਸੱਟ ਲੱਗੀ ਹੈ'.
'is' is the contracted copula in the seed's "he's happy", so it is a clitic-fused gloss of ਹੈ and not a defect to cut.
'ਕਿ => that' glosses a particle the seed target ('Yes I'm sure he's going to be okay') drops.
'ਨਹੀਂ => not' glosses the negation inside 'nobody told me', where the seed's English has no separate 'not'.
'not' is the negation fused into "didn't hear" in the seed ("I didn't hear what she said to him").
'not' is the negation fused into "didn't ask" in "I didn't ask if he wanted to follow us."
'to come' matches the LEGO 'ਸਾਡੇ ਪਿੱਛੇ ਆਉਣਾ', but the seed says 'to follow us', so the LEGO and its row disagree with the seed.
'behind us' matches the LEGO 'ਸਾਡੇ ਪਿੱਛੇ', but the seed says 'follow us' and its known says 'ਸਾਡੇ ਨਾਲ', so the LEGO differs from the seed.
'is mine' glosses 'ਮੇਰਾ ਹੈ', and the seed has the contraction "that one's mine", where 'is' is clitic-fused and not contiguous.
'I would have driven' matches the LEGO 'I would have happily driven', but the seed says "I'd have been happy to drive", so the LEGO differs from the seed.
'ਕੋਈ => any' is a literal gloss of a word inside L1 'ਕੋਈ ਇਤਰਾਜ਼ ਨਹੀਂ => I don't mind', and the seed's English "don't mind" has no 'any'.
'ਕੋਈ => any' is a literal gloss of a word inside L2 'ਕੋਈ ਪਰਵਾਹ ਨਹੀਂ => don't care about', and the seed's English has no 'any'.
'thought' is the past form of 'think', and the seed has "didn't think", so it is an inflected form of a word in the sentence.
'ਕੀਤੀ ਸੀ => did' is the light verb in 'ਉਮੀਦ ਕੀਤੀ ਸੀ' (we hoped), and the seed's 'hoped' renders it, so the row is about its sentence.
